retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for creating maximalist 90s-era Southern rap album covers featuring heavy diamond-encrusted jewelry, lightning effects, and layered digital textures.

recipe.visualDefinition: A maximalist digital collage centered around a large, circular diamond-encrusted medallion and chain, set against a dark, atmospheric background with lightning strikes and glowing nebulas.
coreVisualRelationships: Central circular medallion as the primary focal point
Intertwined silver chains framing the central graphic
High-contrast lightning bolts cutting through a dark blue/purple background
Layered typography with varying textures from metallic to script
coreInvariants: Diamond-pave texture on primary central elements
High-gloss metallic reflections on all jewelry components
Atmospheric glow or halo effect around the central circular motif

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central medallion occupies 60% of the frame, surrounded by a winding chain.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular emblem with large diamond-filled characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the chain, leading from the top corners down to the central medallion.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; corners are filled with secondary text and thematic props like a notepad and stamp.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and royal blue background with purple nebula accents.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and silver from the diamond reflections and lightning.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold or brassy yellow outlines on the jewelry and script text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the brilliant white highlights of the 'iced out' elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and elegant scripts
letterConstructionRules: Primary display text must be filled with a repeating diamond-pave texture
Letters feature thick gold or silver bevelled borders
Secondary text uses high-contrast serif fonts with metallic gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters within the medallion are integrated into the jewelry structure
Top-level display text features a vertical gradient and thin outline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, textured industrial display type paired with elegant, thin-stroke formal script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab-serif skeleton needed for the diamond-fill treatment.
Matches the elegant, flourished secondary text at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark blue and purple nebula background with electric white lightning bolts. Place a large 3D silver chain in a circular arrangement in the center, leaving space for text inside the circle and at the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a diamond-pave texture to the central display lettering. Add a gold bevel to the edges. Place the script text in the bottom left with a gold metallic gradient.

verificationChecks: Is the central text filled with a diamond texture?
Are there lightning bolts in the background?
Is the composition centered around a circular medallion?
Is there a contrast between heavy slab-serifs and thin script?

adjustableVariables: Color of the metallic bevel (gold vs silver)
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'iced out' diamond texture on main letters
Ensure lightning effects don't obscure the text
Verify the 3D bevel effect on the medallion
Confirm the presence of the circular chain frame
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Medallion + Diamond Texture + Lightning Background + Slab/Script Pairing = Southern Bling Aesthetic
